rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for natural scenery, views, and landscapes.

example.english: The scenery here is really beautiful.
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 ge3 fung1 ging2 zan1 hai6 hou2 leng3

rows.note: Use this specifically for stage scenery, including backdrops and set pieces.

example.english: The scenery for this play looks very realistic.
example.traditional: 呢齣劇嘅布景整得好逼真。
example.jyutping: ni1 ceot1 kek6 ge3 bou3 ging2 zing2 dak1 hou2 bik1 zan1
